title: SmpRules
description: Server-side rule pack for a PVP-style SMP: a single craftable Mace, no pvp damage for End Crystals and Respawn Anchors, openable Nether & End, combat-log and elytra-mace protection, and a 3000-block border — all tweakable from the console.
body:
# SmpRules

A server-side rule pack for a hardcore-style SMP. Everything is configurable, and most of it can be changed live from the console — no restarts needed.

## Features

### Items
- **One Mace per server.** Only a single Mace can ever be crafted. The holder shows up on everyone's locator bar, so the only way to get it is to hunt them down.
- **End Crystals & Respawn Anchors banned** — can't be crafted, placed, or used. Their explosions also deal no damage to players.
- **Command-driven item limits.** Ban or limit *any* item live:
  - `/smprules ban <item>` — no crafting, placing, or use
  - `/smprules limit <item> <count>` — only N craftable server-wide
  - `/smprules allow <item>` — remove a limit
  - `/smprules list | info | reset | reload`

### Dimensions
- **Open and close the Nether and End** on your schedule:
  - `/dimension open <nether|end>` / `/dimension close <nether|end>` / `/dimension status`
- Both start **closed**. A closed dimension can't be portaled into, and closing one sends anyone inside back to the overworld.

### Combat
- **No combat logging** — disconnecting in combat kills you (and drops your gear).
- **No elytra in combat** — you can't glide while combat-tagged.
- **No elytra-macing** — Mace hits set up by gliding are blocked.

### World
- **3000-block world border** (Nether auto-scaled to match coordinates).
- **Locator bar disabled** for everyone except the current Mace holder.

## Commands & permissions
| Command | Permission |
|---|---|
| `/smprules ...` | `smprules.admin` (op) |
| `/dimension ...` (alias `/dim`) | `smprules.dimensions` (op) |
| Ignore item limits | `smprules.items.bypass` |

## Requirements
- Paper server
- Configurable via `config.yml`, `items.yml`, and `dimensions.yml`
